final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault GROUP BY o.ordertune), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.record_count, s1.record_count - s2.avg_count AS count_above_average FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s2.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND s1.record_count > s2.avg_count) SELECT AVG(record_count), AVG(count_above_average) FROM step3
